run_gtest_list_tests: run the googletest-list-tests-unittest_ executable with args and return the list of tests printed
test_gtest_list_tests_flag: test the --gtest_list_tests flag by running the test executable and verifying output matches expected regex
run_and_verify_tests: run googletest-list-tests-unittest_ with a flag value and verify output matches an expected regex pattern
test_default_behavior: test the default mode behavior when gtest_list_tests flag is not set
test_with_filter_flags: test that --gtest_list_tests takes into account the --gtest_filter flag for filtering test output
